claim_1.claim: ELISA analysis of serum from healthy young adults vaccinated with MCV4 (n=17) at days 0, 7, 30, 180 and 750 post-vaccination showed that MCV4 induced robust polysaccharide-specific IgG binding antibody responses against meningococcal serogroups A and C compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Both vaccines induced robust polysaccharide-specific IgG binding antibody responses against serogroups A and C, as measured by ELISA.

claim_2.claim: ELISA analysis of serum from healthy young adults vaccinated with MCV4 (n=17) at days 0, 7, 30, 180 and 750 post-vaccination showed that the polysaccharide-specific IgG binding antibody response peaked at day 30 compared to earlier and later timepoints.

sources.quote: These responses peaked at day 30 (MCV4) or day 180 (MPSV4) (Fig. 1a).

claim_3.claim: ELISA analysis of serum from healthy young adults vaccinated with MPSV4 (n=13) at days 0, 7, 30, 180 and 750 post-vaccination showed that MPSV4 induced robust polysaccharide-specific IgG binding antibody responses against meningococcal serogroups A and C compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Both vaccines induced robust polysaccharide-specific IgG binding antibody responses against serogroups A and C, as measured by ELISA.

claim_4.claim: ELISA analysis of serum from healthy young adults vaccinated with MPSV4 (n=13) at days 0, 7, 30, 180 and 750 post-vaccination showed that the polysaccharide-specific IgG binding antibody response peaked at day 180 compared to earlier and later timepoints.

sources.quote: These responses peaked at day 30 (MCV4) or day 180 (MPSV4) (Fig. 1a).

claim_5.claim: ELISA analysis of serum from healthy young adults vaccinated with MCV4 (n=17) and MPSV4 (n=13) at days 0, 7, 30, 180 and 750 post-vaccination showed greater magnitude of the polysaccharide-specific IgG binding antibody response after MPSV4 compared to a single dose of MCV4.

sources.quote: The magnitude and duration of the polysaccharide-specific IgG response was greater with MPSV4 compared to a single dose of MCV4 (Fig. 1a).

claim_6.claim: ELISA analysis of serum from healthy young adults vaccinated with MCV4 (n=17) and MPSV4 (n=13) at days 0, 7, 30, 180 and 750 post-vaccination showed greater duration of the polysaccharide-specific IgG binding antibody response after MPSV4 compared to a single dose of MCV4.

sources.quote: The magnitude and duration of the polysaccharide-specific IgG response was greater with MPSV4 compared to a single dose of MCV4 (Fig. 1a).

claim_7.claim: ELISA analysis of serum from healthy young adults vaccinated with MCV4 (n=17) at days 0, 7 and 30 post-vaccination showed that MCV4 induced polysaccharide-specific IgG1 and IgG2 antibody responses compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Both MPSV4 and MCV4 induced polysaccharide-specific IgG2 and IgG1 antibody responses (Fig. 1b), as well as specific IgM antibody titers, which continued to rise until at least day 30 (Fig. 1c).

claim_8.claim: ELISA analysis of serum from healthy young adults vaccinated with MPSV4 (n=13) at days 0, 7 and 30 post-vaccination showed that MPSV4 induced polysaccharide-specific IgG1 and IgG2 antibody responses compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Both MPSV4 and MCV4 induced polysaccharide-specific IgG2 and IgG1 antibody responses (Fig. 1b), as well as specific IgM antibody titers, which continued to rise until at least day 30 (Fig. 1c).

claim_9.claim: ELISA analysis of serum from healthy young adults vaccinated with MCV4 (n=17) at days 0, 7 and 30 post-vaccination showed that polysaccharide-specific IgM antibody titers continued to rise until at least day 30 compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Both MPSV4 and MCV4 induced polysaccharide-specific IgG2 and IgG1 antibody responses (Fig. 1b), as well as specific IgM antibody titers, which continued to rise until at least day 30 (Fig. 1c).

claim_10.claim: ELISA analysis of serum from healthy young adults vaccinated with MPSV4 (n=13) at days 0, 7 and 30 post-vaccination showed that polysaccharide-specific IgM antibody titers continued to rise until at least day 30 compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Both MPSV4 and MCV4 induced polysaccharide-specific IgG2 and IgG1 antibody responses (Fig. 1b), as well as specific IgM antibody titers, which continued to rise until at least day 30 (Fig. 1c).

claim_11.claim: ELISA analysis of serum from healthy young adults vaccinated with MPSV4 (n=13) and MCV4 (n=17) at days 0, 7, 30, 180 and 750 post-vaccination showed that two years after immunization (day 750), polysaccharide-specific IgG induced by MPSV4 remained significantly elevated whereas the response induced by the primary dose of MCV4 had declined, compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Two years after immunization, there was still a significant concentration of polysaccharide-specific IgG response induced by MPSV4, whereas the response induced by the primary dose of MCV4 had declined, although it stayed substantially above baseline (Fig. 1a).

claim_12.claim: serum bactericidal assay (SBA) analysis of serum from healthy young adults vaccinated with MCV4 (n=17) at days 0, 7, 30, 180 and 750 post-vaccination showed that MCV4 induced a rapid increase in serum bactericidal activity detectable by day 7, peaking at day 30 and remaining substantially above baseline at day 750 compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Both vaccines induced a rapid increase in serum bactericidal activity (SBA), which was detectable as early as day 7, peaked at day 30, began to decline by day 180, yet remained substantially above baseline at day 750 (Fig. 1d).

claim_13.claim: serum bactericidal assay (SBA) analysis of serum from healthy young adults vaccinated with MPSV4 (n=13) at days 0, 7, 30, 180 and 750 post-vaccination showed that MPSV4 induced a rapid increase in serum bactericidal activity detectable by day 7, peaking at day 30 and remaining substantially above baseline at day 750 compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Both vaccines induced a rapid increase in serum bactericidal activity (SBA), which was detectable as early as day 7, peaked at day 30, began to decline by day 180, yet remained substantially above baseline at day 750 (Fig. 1d).

claim_14.claim: serum bactericidal assay (SBA) analysis of serum from healthy young adults vaccinated with MCV4 (n=17) and MPSV4 (n=13) at days 0, 7, 30, 180 and 750 post-vaccination showed that MPSV4 only trended toward greater serum bactericidal activity titers than MCV4, with a less pronounced between-vaccine difference than for ELISA binding titers.

sources.quote: Although there was a trend for MPVS4 to induce greater SBA titers than MCV4 (Fig. 1d), the difference in the magnitude of the SBA titers was not as pronounced as that observed with the magnitude of the ELISA binding titers (Fig. 1a).

claim_15.claim: serum bactericidal assay (SBA) analysis of serum from healthy young adults vaccinated with MCV4 (n=17) and MPSV4 (n=13) at days 0, 7, 30, 180 and 750 post-vaccination showed that protective SBA titers of 1:8 or higher were maintained in the majority of vaccinees at day 750 with no difference between the two vaccine groups compared to each other.

sources.quote: An SBA titer of 1:8 or higher, a correlate of protective immunity 22, was maintained in the majority of MPSV4 and MCV4 vaccinees two years after inoculation, with no difference observed between the two vaccine groups (Fig. 1d).

claim_16.claim: anti-DT IgG capture microsphere assay analysis of serum from healthy young adults vaccinated with MCV4 (n=17) at days 0, 7 and 30 post-vaccination showed that MCV4 elicited a strong anti-diphtheria toxoid IgG response at days 7 and 30 compared to baseline (day 0).

assay.obi_label: antibody detection by cytometric bead array assay

sources.quote: MCV4, which contains the diphtheria toxoid (DT) protein as a conjugate, elicited a strong anti-DT IgG response at days 7 and 30, whereas MPSV4 containing polysaccharide alone did not (Fig. 1e).

claim_17.claim: anti-DT IgG capture microsphere assay analysis of serum from healthy young adults vaccinated with MPSV4 (n=13) at days 0, 7 and 30 post-vaccination showed that MPSV4 did not elicit an anti-diphtheria toxoid IgG response compared to MCV4.

assay.obi_label: antibody detection by cytometric bead array assay

sources.quote: MCV4, which contains the diphtheria toxoid (DT) protein as a conjugate, elicited a strong anti-DT IgG response at days 7 and 30, whereas MPSV4 containing polysaccharide alone did not (Fig. 1e).

claim_18.claim: flow cytometry analysis of whole blood from healthy young adults vaccinated with MCV4 (n=17) at days 0, 3, 7 and 14 post-vaccination showed that antibody secreting cells peaked at day 7 compared to baseline (day 0) and other sampled timepoints.

sources.quote: The ASCs showed a peak at day 7 in both vaccines (Fig. 1f).

claim_19.claim: flow cytometry analysis of whole blood from healthy young adults vaccinated with MPSV4 (n=13) at days 0, 3, 7 and 14 post-vaccination showed that antibody secreting cells peaked at day 7 compared to baseline (day 0) and other sampled timepoints.

sources.quote: The ASCs showed a peak at day 7 in both vaccines (Fig. 1f).

claim_20.claim: flow cytometry analysis of whole blood from healthy young adults vaccinated with MCV4 (n=17) and MPSV4 (n=13) at days 0, 3, 7 and 14 post-vaccination showed that the magnitude of the antibody secreting cell response was lower after MPSV4 than after MCV4 compared to each other.

sources.quote: Surprisingly, even though a greater polysaccharide-specific antibody response was induced by MPSV4 (Fig. 1a, d), the magnitude of the ASC response induced by MPSV4 was lower than that induced by MCV4 (Fig. 1f).

claim_21.claim: flow cytometry analysis of whole blood from healthy young adults vaccinated with MCV4 (n=17) at day 7 post-vaccination showed that the percentage of total antibody secreting cells strongly correlated with serum anti-diphtheria toxoid IgG compared to the anti-polysaccharide IgG response.

sources.quote: Indeed, the percentage of total ASCs in the blood at day 7 after MCV4 vaccination strongly correlated with the serum anti-DT IgG (Fig. 1g), and not with the anti-polysaccharide IgG response (data not shown).

claim_22.claim: ELISpot analysis of blood from a subset of MCV4 vaccinees at day 7 post-vaccination showed that the majority of IgG antibody secreting cells were specific for diphtheria toxoid compared to meningococcal polysaccharide-specific antibody secreting cells.

sources.quote: Polysaccharide- and DT-specific ELISpots in a subset of MCV4 vaccinees revealed that the majority of IgG ASCs detected in the blood at day 7 were specific for DT (Supplementary Fig. 1a, b).

claim_23.claim: microarray analysis of PBMCs from healthy young adults vaccinated with MCV4 (n=17) at days 0, 3 and 7 post-vaccination showed 1,150 differentially expressed genes at day 7 compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: At day 7 post-vaccination, we identified 1,150 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) in MCV4 vaccinees (Fig. 2a).

claim_24.claim: microarray analysis of PBMCs from healthy young adults vaccinated with MCV4 (n=17) at day 7 post-vaccination showed that the differentially expressed genes bore the hallmark of antibody secreting cells compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: These DEGs bear the hallmark of antibody secreting cells (ASC), which is consistent with the enhanced frequencies of these cells (Fig. 1f).

claim_25.claim: microarray analysis of PBMCs from healthy young adults vaccinated with MCV4 (n=17) at day 7 post-vaccination showed that the XBP1-regulated transcriptional network was highly enriched among upregulated genes compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: This XBP1 network is also highly enriched for up-regulated genes at day 7 post-MCV4 vaccination (Supplementary Fig. 2).

claim_26.claim: microarray analysis of PBMCs from healthy young adults vaccinated with MCV4 (n=17) and MPSV4 (n=13) at days 0, 3 and 7 post-vaccination showed that only a small number of differentially expressed genes were identified at day 3 for both vaccines and at day 7 for MPSV4 compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: However, only a small number of DEGs were identified at day 3 post-vaccination for both MPSV4 and MCV4, and at day 7 for MPSV4 (Fig. 2a).

claim_27.claim: microarray analysis of PBMCs from vaccine recipients across five vaccine datasets showed that several B cell genes, including TNFRSF17, were upregulated at day 7 in MCV4 and TIV vaccinees compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Several B cell genes were up-regulated at day 7 in MCV4 and TIV vaccinees (Fig. 3b), including TNFRSF17, a B cell differentiation gene that is predictive of antibody responses to the YF-17D and TIV vaccines 4, 6.

claim_28.claim: microarray analysis of PBMCs from vaccine recipients across five vaccine datasets showed that innate immunity and interferon response genes including OAS1, OAS2, STAT1, STAT2 and TRIM22 were upregulated at day 3 after live attenuated virus vaccination compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Genes associated with innate immunity and interferon responses, such as OAS1, OAS2, STAT1, STAT2 and TRIM22 were up-regulated at day 3 post-vaccination with live attenuated virus vaccines (Fig. 3b).

claim_29.claim: microarray analysis of PBMC transcriptomes from recipients of YF-17D, TIV, MPSV4 and MCV4, using blood transcription module analysis, showed that day 3 antibody-correlation profiles separated into three distinctive patterns representing protein recall responses, polysaccharide responses and primary viral responses compared to the other vaccine-response classes.

sources.quote: Yet to our surprise, the early BTM correlation profiles at day 3 displayed three distinctive patterns (Fig. 5a and Supplementary Fig. 11) that represent the protein recall response (shared by TIV and MCV4 anti-DT), the polysaccharide response (shared by MPSV4 and MCV4 anti-PS) and primary the viral response (YF-17D).

claim_30.claim: microarray analysis of PBMC transcriptomes from YF-17D vaccinees, using blood transcription module analysis, showed that higher antibody responses were associated with greater interferon-response and cell-adhesion module activity compared to lower antibody responses.

sources.quote: In the primary viral response (Fig. 5a, b, Supplementary Fig. 12), higher antibody response is associated with greater activity in interferon response and cell adhesion modules.

claim_31.claim: microarray analysis of PBMC transcriptomes from YF-17D vaccinees, using blood transcription module analysis, showed that cell-division modules including PLK1 signaling events were inversely correlated with antibody responses compared to higher-antibody responders.

sources.quote: Inversely correlated to the antibody response are a number of cell division modules, including PLK1 signaling events.

claim_32.claim: microarray analysis of PBMC transcriptomes from MPSV4 and MCV4 vaccinees, using blood transcription module analysis, showed that day 3 anti-polysaccharide antibody responses were associated with modules for antigen-presenting cells and their activation, complement, and proinflammatory cytokines compared to lower anti-polysaccharide responders.

sources.quote: The anti-polysaccharide response at day 3 (Fig. 5a, top; Supplementary Fig. 12) contains a number of modules associated with antigen presenting cells and their activation, as well as complement and proinflammatory cytokines (Fig. 5b).

claim_33.claim: microarray analysis of PBMC transcriptomes from MPSV4 and MCV4 vaccinees, using blood transcription module analysis, showed that anti-polysaccharide antibody responses correlated with a dendritic-cell surface signature including CD83, HLA-DR and HLA-DQ compared to lower anti-polysaccharide responders.

sources.quote: Gene members of these modules include dendritic cell (DC) markers: CD83, HLA-DR and HLA-DQ (Supplementary Fig. 14), and inflammatory cytokines: CCL20 and IL1B (Supplementary Fig. 13). The correlation of DC surface signature module to anti-polysaccharide IgG in both MCV4 and MPSV4 is shown (Supplementary Fig. 14b).

claim_34.claim: microarray analysis of PBMC transcriptomes from TIV and MCV4 vaccinees, using blood transcription module analysis, showed that day 3 HAI titers and diphtheria toxoid-specific antibody titers were associated with a protein recall transcriptional program enriched for monocyte features, especially Toll-like receptor signaling, compared to lower antibody responders.

sources.quote: The modules whose activity on day 3 correlate with HAI titers (TIV) and the DT-specific antibody titers (MCV4) are likely be part of a transcriptomic program associated with protein recall responses (Fig. 5a, lower right; Supplementary Fig. 12). This program displays many monocyte features, especially of Toll-like receptor (TLR) signaling.

claim_35.claim: microarray analysis of PBMC transcriptomes from TIV and MCV4 vaccinees, using blood transcription module analysis, showed that plasma-cell and memory-B-cell modules at day 7 were positively correlated with antibody responses in both vaccines compared to lower antibody responders.

sources.quote: Plasma and memory B cell modules at day 7 are indeed positively correlated with the antibody response in both vaccines (Supplementary Fig. 18).

claim_36.claim: flow cytometry analysis of human myeloid dendritic cells and monocyte-derived dendritic cells stimulated in vitro with MPSV4 or MCV4 showed that MPSV4 induced upregulation of the co-stimulatory molecules CD80, CD83, HLA-DR and CD86 compared to MCV4 or medium control.

sources.quote: Up-regulation of co-stimulatory molecules and secretion of IL-6, TNF and IL-12p40 was detected in human DCs stimulated by MPSV4 (Fig. 6a).

claim_37.claim: 27-plex cytokines (Luminex) analysis of plasma from healthy young adults vaccinated with MCV4 (n=17) and MPSV4 (n=13) at days 0, 3 and 7 post-vaccination showed little cytokine change after either vaccine compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Consistent with this, analysis of plasma cytokines revealed little change induced by either vaccine (Supplementary Fig. 3).

claim_38.claim: ELISA kits analysis of human dendritic-cell culture supernatants stimulated in vitro with MPSV4 showed secretion of IL-6, TNF and IL-12p40 compared to MCV4 or medium control.

sources.quote: Up-regulation of co-stimulatory molecules and secretion of IL-6, TNF and IL-12p40 was detected in human DCs stimulated by MPSV4 (Fig. 6a).
